title: Zombie Scenario - Survival music
summary: The in-round combat theme for the survival stages of Zombie Scenario: Season 2.
description: Listed on the Zombie Scenario: Season 2 page under the 'Survival music' heading of its Sounds section (one of four tracks across three categories). It accompanies the wave-survival portions of the season's chapters, as opposed to the pursuit and boss cue. Title, composer and audio file were not exposed by the digest.
_confidence: medium (category label from the wiki; official title unknown)
